items.title: Average-case generalized-inner-product lower bounds for formulas with low-communication leaf gates
items.author: Valentine Kabanets; Sajin Koroth; Zhenjian Lu; Dimitrios Myrisiotis; Igor C. Oliveira
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete41-page five-author CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem1 Item1/detailedTheorem19 with entireSection3 authorproof andAppendixA.1 bearing proofs. Nonexclusive nativev1 private aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The proof converts correlation with a formula of randomized low-communication leaves into correlation with a parity of few deterministic low-communication leaves, via pointwise approximation and a coefficient-mass argument, then transfers multiparty GIP hardness to an average-case formula-size lower bound.
